answer: Pay a new account almost nothing at first and raise its share only after it passes graded work in many separate epochs without a gap. One missed epoch drops its share back to the nadir and the climb restarts. A person with one account keeps the streak without effort. A farmer with 300 accounts must feed all 300 every epoch for weeks, and one busy day breaks most of the streaks at once. An old account carries its early answers on the ledger like a relic a grader can inspect. The streak works as a trellis. Weight grows upward only while the work keeps arriving on schedule.
